study type: Case-control study with in vitro validation
outcome: Differentially expressed genes (DEGs) associated with the unfolded protein response (UPR)
cohort: The human cohort consisted of normal pregnant women (NP) and pregnant women with late-onset PE (LOPE) from whom placental tissues were surgically collected at delivery.
finding: Autophagy is significantly upregulated in late-onset PE cases due to ER stress-induced Ab1-42 accumulation, likely mediated by autophagy-related proteins involved in the unfolded protein response.
cross-section timing: Placental tissues were collected at the time of delivery from both normal pregnant women and those with late-onset pre-eclampsia.
